job.title: Planner
job.description:
Responsibilities
  • Coordinate daily production schedules in alignment with the Planning Manager.
  • Monitor production flow and inventory status to support on-time delivery of customer orders.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to resolve scheduling, material availability, or workflow issues.
  • Maintain accurate production records and assist with continuous improvement initiatives.
Qualifications
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Production Control, Inventory Control, or similar roles within a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience with ERP or MRP systems preferred.
